description: This file defines the interface and mock implementation for a Dummy Spnego Authenticator used in Android, including constants, data structures, and classes for testing GSSAPI negotiate authentication.

classes.name: GssContextMockImpl
classes.description: A mock implementation of a GSSAPI context used for testing, containing context details such as source and target names, lifetime, mechanism type, flags, and state.

classes.name: DummySpnegoAuthenticator
classes.description: An interface class for controlling the DummySpnegoAuthenticator service, including methods for setting expectations, retrieving queries, and managing test state.

methods.name: SecurityContextQuery
methods.description: A struct representing a security context query with expected parameters and tokens.

methods.name: GetTokenToReturn
methods.description: Returns the token to be used in Java calls.

methods.name: GetResult
methods.description: Returns the result code of the last operation.

methods.name: CheckGetTokenArguments
methods.description: Checks the arguments passed to the GetToken method from Java.

methods.name: ExpectSecurityContext
methods.description: Sets an expected security context for testing.

methods.name: EnsureTestAccountExists
methods.description: Static method to ensure a test account exists.

methods.name: RemoveTestAccounts
methods.description: Static method to remove test accounts.

methods.name: GetNextQuery
methods.description: Retrieves the next query from the queue.

methods.name: CheckQueueNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that the query queue is not empty.
